<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="bpmnQuoteApproval_definitions" targetNamespace="https://aisep.example/model/procurement/" exporter="AISEP tools/aisep.py diagram">
  <bpmn:process id="bpmnQuoteApproval" name="报价审批流程" isExecutable="false" processType="Private">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="bpmnStart" name="收到报价单">
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="bpmnEnd" name="审批完成">
      <bpmn:incoming>sf5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>sf6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="bpmnFirstLevel" name="一级审批">
      <bpmn:incoming>sf3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="bpmnReview" name="审核报价单">
      <bpmn:incoming>sf1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="bpmnSecondLevel" name="二级审批">
      <bpmn:incoming>sf4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="bpmnAmountGateway" name="金额超过10万?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="sf3">
      <bpmn:incoming>sf2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>sf4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf1" sourceRef="bpmnStart" targetRef="bpmnReview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf2" sourceRef="bpmnReview" targetRef="bpmnAmountGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf3" sourceRef="bpmnAmountGateway" targetRef="bpmnFirstLevel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf4" sourceRef="bpmnAmountGateway" targetRef="bpmnSecondLevel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf5" sourceRef="bpmnFirstLevel" targetRef="bpmnEnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="sf6" sourceRef="bpmnSecondLevel" targetRef="bpmnEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="bpmnQuoteApproval_diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="bpmnQuoteApproval_plane" bpmnElement="bpmnQuoteApproval">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnStart_di" bpmnElement="bpmnStart">
        <dc:Bounds x="42" y="60" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="30" y="101" width="59" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnEnd_di" bpmnElement="bpmnEnd">
        <dc:Bounds x="611" y="58" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="605" y="99" width="48" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnFirstLevel_di" bpmnElement="bpmnFirstLevel">
        <dc:Bounds x="445" y="30" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnReview_di" bpmnElement="bpmnReview">
        <dc:Bounds x="149" y="38" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnSecondLevel_di" bpmnElement="bpmnSecondLevel">
        <dc:Bounds x="445" y="150" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnAmountGateway_di" bpmnElement="bpmnAmountGateway" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="322" y="53" width="50" height="50" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="309" y="108" width="76" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf1_di" bpmnElement="sf1">
        <di:waypoint x="78" y="78" />
        <di:waypoint x="149" y="78" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf2_di" bpmnElement="sf2">
        <di:waypoint x="249" y="78" />
        <di:waypoint x="322" y="78" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf3_di" bpmnElement="sf3">
        <di:waypoint x="372" y="70" />
        <di:waypoint x="445" y="70" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf4_di" bpmnElement="sf4">
        <di:waypoint x="372" y="87" />
        <di:waypoint x="395" y="87" />
        <di:waypoint x="395" y="190" />
        <di:waypoint x="445" y="190" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf5_di" bpmnElement="sf5">
        <di:waypoint x="545" y="70" />
        <di:waypoint x="611" y="70" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="sf6_di" bpmnElement="sf6">
        <di:waypoint x="545" y="190" />
        <di:waypoint x="555" y="190" />
        <di:waypoint x="555" y="82" />
        <di:waypoint x="611" y="82" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
title: 报价审批流程
